title: Equality of Two Randomized Polynomial-Time Classes
statement: The class of languages decidable by a randomized Turing machine with a polynomial bound on the cumulative probabilities of not yet having halted, acceptance probability arbitrarily close to at least $2/3$ on members, and no accepting output on any halted branch for nonmembers, equals the class of languages decidable in polynomial time with one-sided error: members are accepted with probability at least $2/3$, and nonmembers are never accepted.
